values.note: FS: 25 sites, parking spurs 16-30 ft, maximum RV 24 ft; vehicles must fit the spur. The catalog lists 24 sites at 20-55 ft (19 at 25 ft or more, five at 20 ft: 004, 007, 013, 019, 023); 003 and 022 are pull-through. Two vehicles or one RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kenosha-pass-campground ('This campground has 25 campsites ... with parking spurs 16-30 feet long'; 'A maximum RV length of 24 feet is allowed') + recreation.gov catalog 233185 (Max Vehicle Length per site; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on 003 and 022) + rec.gov notice 'Vehicles must fit on parking spur', read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233185 (notice 'No RV hookups') + catalog 233185 (all 24 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump; water, trash and the host may be absent in the extended fall season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kenosha-pass-campground ('Vault toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available'; 'an extended season when services such as water, trash or a host may not be available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late May to late September, weather dependent; full service Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, then an extended season with reduced services (FS).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/kenosha-pass-campground ('This campground is open from late May to late September, dependent on the weather'; 'Seasons of Use: Late May to late September'; 'Visitors may expect full service from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 18 of the 24 catalogued sites reservable, six first-come; the whole campground is first-come for two weeks after Labor Day (2026: Sept 7-19). Booking closes 4 days before arrival. Two nights on weekends, three on holiday weekends (not marked soft). Run by the concessionaire ExplorUS.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233185 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4) + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 09-06; First-come, First-served Season 09-07 to 09-19) + catalog 233185 (6 sites Not Reservable), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a site, including two vehicles or one RV; a third vehicle is $11.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233185/rates (2026 Peak STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28; 2026 first-come 28; 2027 Peak 28) + FS page ('$28 fee per site for overnight ... $11 fee for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-28

note: Small Pike NF campground at ~10,000 ft at the summit of Kenosha Pass on US-285, in lodgepole and aspen; the Colorado Trail runs through it, and the Kenosha Pass Interpretive Area (wetlands, old South Park railroad) is across the highway. Dirt and gravel parking aprons. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 25 sites, no hookups, vault toilets, hand-pump water, $28 (2026 and 2027). Added max RV 24 ft (FS), pull-through (catalog 003, 022), season note late May-late September, booking.season 05-22..09-06, 14-night max, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 4-day cutoff, some first-come sites. Note trimmed of field facts.
